cloud.title: Kidde HomeSafe account
cloud.description: Sign in with the account used in the Kidde app. The polling interval can be changed later under the integration's options.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Kidde HomeSafe
reauth_confirm.description: The Kidde cloud rejected the stored session. Enter your credentials to sign in again.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Kidde HomeSafe
reconfigure.description: Update the account credentials used to poll the Kidde cloud.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Discovered Kidde alarm
bluetooth_confirm.description: Add {name}? It will be monitored locally through Bluetooth advertisements (no cloud connection required).

pick_bluetooth.title: Select a Kidde alarm
pick_bluetooth.description: Kidde alarms discovered over Bluetooth. Alarms already added are not listed.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration flow is already in progress
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured Kidde alarms were found over Bluetooth. Make sure a Bluetooth adapter or Bluetooth proxy is in range of the alarm.
abort.nothing_to_reconfigure: Bluetooth alarms have nothing to reconfigure. Remove and re-add the entry to change the tracked alarm.
abort.wrong_account: The credentials belong to a different Kidde account than this entry.

data_description.update_interval: How often to poll the Kidde cloud. Lower values reduce the delay between a device event and Home Assistant seeing it, at the cost of more API traffic.

abort.nothing_to_configure: Bluetooth alarms update passively from advertisements and have no options.
